name: Stillwater Pond
summary: Stillwater Pond is a quiet, stagnant body of water resting just west of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Once a beloved picnic and swimming spot for the living children of Lordaeron, it has decayed into a murky pool inhabited by skeletal fish and prowled by dangerous scavengers.

sections.title: A Ruined Respite
sections.body: Before the Third War and the ravages of the Plague of Undeath, Stillwater Pond served as a tranquil retreat for the folk of Tirisfal Glades. Families from nearby hamlets gathered on its grassy banks for afternoon picnics, and children too young to brave the treacherous depths of Brightwater Lake learned to swim in its shallows. Today, the idyllic waters have turned lifeless and gray. The living have long vanished, leaving only skeletal fish darting beneath the surface and wandering undead drifting through the surrounding woods.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Mist
sections.body: Though quiet compared to the besieged roads and contested farms of Tirisfal, Stillwater Pond holds its own perils. The murky waters provide water only to the blighted beasts of the glades, most notably a ferocious darkhound named Bayne who stalks the shoreline. Travelers cutting through the western meadows on their way toward Brill must tread carefully, as predatory beasts and aimless zombies frequently linger along the water's edge.

faq.q: What was Stillwater Pond like before the Plague?
aliases: what was stillwater pond used for
faq.answer: In the days of human Lordaeron, Stillwater Pond was a scenic and popular spot for local picnics. Because it was shallow and calmer than the expansive Brightwater Lake, families frequently brought young children here to swim safely.

faq.q: Is there anything living in the water now?
faq.answer: Normal aquatic life did not survive the blighting of Tirisfal. The only things swimming beneath the gray surface are the animated, skeletal remains of fish left behind by the Scourge's corruption.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures wander near the pond?
faq.answer: Apart from mindless undead wandering the glades, the most notorious threat along the shore is Bayne, an unusually powerful and aggressive darkhound who feeds on unwary travelers.
Stillwater Pond sits in central Tirisfal Glades, directly west of the town of Brill and southwest of the larger Brightwater Lake.

angles.text: For Forsaken who retain memories of life in Lordaeron, Stillwater Pond stands as a grim reminder of lost childhood days spent picnicking and swimming along its once-clear banks.
The blighted wildlife around the pond, including feral darkhounds like Bayne, makes the area a hazardous hunting ground for scouts patrolling the outskirts of Brill.
